links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT pediatric treatment recommendations by disease type, question type, and error category
links.effect: Overall accuracy 82.2% (95% CI 81.0%-83.4%); common diseases 84.4%; prone to errors in disease definitions, medications, and surgical treatment.
links.quote: However, it was prone to errors in disease definitions, medications, and surgical treatment.

links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy by response language (English vs Chinese)
links.effect: Accuracy was 93.0% (95% CI: 91.9%-94.1%) in English, notably higher than the 82.2% overall, implying substantially lower accuracy in Chinese.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved an overall accuracy of 82.2% (95% CI: 81.0%-83.4%), with superior performance in addressing common diseases (84.4%, 95% CI: 83.2%-85.7%), offering general treatment advice (83.5%, 95% CI: 81.9%-85.1%), and responding in English (93.0%, 95% CI: 91.9%-94.1%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy on 4,160 pediatric clinical consultation questions across English and Chinese without evaluating a deployment guardrail or organizational practice.
